<!-- ===========================================================================
     Logic diagram 2 of 3 - the null-model ladder
     Take-home Exercise 1 | ISSS626

     The report's central methodological result, drawn. Rungs are ordered by
     how flexible the null model is, not by the order they were tried, because
     the finding is that the p-value tracks that flexibility and not the
     data. The two kernel rungs are boxed together: same data, same statistic,
     opposite verdicts.

     Canvas 1000 x 480. Shapes once, labels twice (.en / .zh); see the note at
     the top of dg-pipeline.qmd.
     =========================================================================== -->
::: {.diagram}
